title: Generics, associated types and opaque return types

videos.script: The planner needs the first and last session of a week. And the first and last course of a track. {{functions}} Written plainly, that is two functions with the same body. A generic function is written once, with a placeholder for the type. {{constraints}} Then constraints. A placeholder can do almost nothing, until you say what its type must be able to do. {{types}} Then a generic type, a stack for an undo list. {{associated}} Then protocols that leave a type open, the way every collection does. {{some}} And two small words that look alike. Some, which hides one type the caller does not need. {{any}} And any, a box that can hold a different type each time. You will measure the box, and see what it cannot do.
